text:
yara: Quick heads-up 1: launching a narrow KMS entitlement sweep scoped to data-warehouse exports. Goals: attach owner labels, detect partner/external members, and avoid pruning monthly-run svcaccts. ETA 48h.

matt: I'll own key labeling and export an IAM inventory. Will not change labels without owner confirmation.

leo: I'll run last-used checks and correlate with Airflow schedules. If a svcacct only runs monthly, I'll tag it monthly_flag to avoid false positives.

yara: Ops: can we reserve a canary unbind window Sat 06:00-07:00 UTC? Low export traffic then.

ops-bot: Canary slot proposed: Sat 2024-09-20T06:00:00Z - 2024-09-20T07:00:00Z. Notifying infra oncall.

matt: Read-only commands I'll run: `gcloud kms keys list --location=global --keyring=dw-keyring --format="csv(name,labels)"` and `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy dw-key --location=global --keyring=dw-keyring --format=json`.

leo: Last-used snippet (read-only): `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:svcacct-dw" --limit 1 --format="value(timestamp)"`. Will include log_count_90d + airflow_job_lookup.

yara: Exceptions template: owner, justification, expiry (max 30d), rollback steps, evidence link. Partner keys: require partner confirmation before any prune.

audit-bot: queued scan: /scans/least_priv/1789992468. ETA: 2024-09-20T06:05:00Z. Output path: /shared/audit/least-priv/1789992468/report.json

matt: Uploaded inventory: https://files.redwood/internal/dw/1789992468/kms-inv.csv

leo: Uploaded last-used + Airflow correlation: https://files.redwood/internal/dw/1789992468/lastused.csv. Marked 3 monthly jobs and 1 partner svcacct `serviceAccount:external@partner` as HIGH-RISK.

yara: Reminder: DO NOT prune keys with external members or project-editor/owner bindings without explicit confirmation and a canary.

ops-bot: Owners notified. 48h TTL for owner confirmations.

audit-bot: scan complete. Summary: 29 keys scanned; 6 prune candidates; 3 monthly-job svcaccts flagged; 1 external partner member flagged. Full report: /shared/audit/least-priv/1789992468/report.json

yara: Next steps: 1) owners confirm or file exception 2) infra prepare canary revert runbook 3) security triage exceptions. Will reconvene here after owner responses. Thanks.
